map.曝光值 EV 计算器依据光圈、快门与 ISO 求曝光值，EV 越低画面越亮，适合: The exposure value EV calculator computes EV from aperture, shutter and ISO; lower EV means a brighter scene, suitable for quantitative control of manual exposure, flash and exposure compensation.
map.EV = log₂(N² / t) − log₂(ISO/100)N 为光圈值，: EV = log2(N^2 / t) - log2(ISO/100); N is the aperture value, t is the shutter time
map.由光圈、快门、ISO 求 EV 判断曝光量。: Compute EV from aperture, shutter, ISO to judge exposure.
map.对比不同参数组合的等效曝光。: Compare equivalent exposure of different parameter combinations.
map.：f/8、1/125s、ISO100：EV100 = log2(N²/t) =: : f/8, 1/125s, ISO100: EV100 = log2(N^2/t) = log2(64 x 125) = log2(8000) approx 12.97; this EV corresponds to the outdoor exposure baseline at sunny noon.
map.：EV 相同则曝光量等：f/8·1/125 等效 f/11·1/60（各变一档）: : equal EV means equal exposure: f/8 1/125 is equivalent to f/11 1/60 (each changes one stop); you can swap parameters to keep brightness and adjust blur.
map.曝光值，每 +1 EV 曝光量翻倍；EV100 以 ISO100 为基准，公式: Exposure value: each +1 EV doubles exposure; EV100 uses ISO100 as baseline, formula EV = log2(N^2/t x 100/ISO).
map.EV 高=亮环境（如晴日 EV14+），低=暗环境（室内 EV4–7）；相机自动: High EV = bright environment (e.g. sunny day EV14+), low = dark environment (indoor EV4-7); camera auto-exposure tracks the target EV.
